entries.82cc21a085792474: It states that it will deepen group collaboration with its parent, Saibu Gas Holdings Co., Ltd., and its group, including sharing project land information, to maximize synergies. Under its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended February 2026 through February 2028), it states that in the Real Estate Sales Business it will actively undertake development projects such as redevelopment and mixed-use development, participate in joint businesses with other companies, strengthen land acquisition in the Fukuoka metropolitan area, and focus on supplying environmentally considerate housing such as ZEH and GX-ZEH specification homes. In the Real Estate Management Business, it will strengthen management-related operations as a stock business, and in the Real Estate Rental Business it will selectively acquire rental properties in locations that take future development into account and consider profitability.
